name: the-claw-machine
title: The Claw Machine
description: An arcade claw machine in SVG, its case glazed. A gantry runs the rail across the top, a carriage drops the claw on its cable, the claw closes on a capsule, lifts it clear of the pile and carries it to the chute; one number is the cycle, and the carriage, the cable, the claw and the carried prize all follow it. Nothing is cut away — the case is solid glass over a working machine, with a coin slot and a joystick on the cabinet face. It runs its own loop with a play/pause control, and once paused you can run the claw or drive it with the arrow keys.
